name: Unisex Harness Cowhide Belt
desc:
Our belts are hand cut from top quality, heavy cow hide that is built to last. All belts are stocked with a heavy buckles, but can be interchanged for personal a buckle. Another bonus is that these belts are easily downsized for weight loss!

The types of leather:

Harness Leather: Using an exclusive blend of waxes, oils and tallows, we hot stuff these leathers to bring out their inherent beauty. Through a traditional process called jack glazing, oils are brought to the surface to create a glossy finish that never mask the leather's natural grain.

There are 3 different kinds of belts, the English Bridle tan belts are soft yet slightly stiff, we use this leather also for the Real Nickel Belts. Harness leather belts have the look of buckskin and are the softest while still being durable.

We can add almost any rivet, concho, or other decoration to these belts. Find more information on our custom page.

name: Women's Deerskin Jacket
desc:
Our biker styled jacket is a quality piece made with the rider in mind with a classic look and clean style in addition to outside and inside pockets. Each jacket can be custom designed with or without fringe, pockets and the side laces to give a tighter fit around the waist. Our jackets aren't considered unisex. We suggest that you custom order your jacket so that you get the fit and design that you want.

Other features

  • no lining
  • long sleeves with zipper and snap cuff
  • double finished collar snaps added
  • well-fitting
  • slight shirttail back

Our jackets should be custom ordered for the best fit, please contact us for more information!

name: Western Purse
desc:
Every piece is a work of art - Our Western purse is made from either elk or American bison with a large interior compartment, exterior pocket on the back. It can be converted to a shoulder bag with purse strap included.

This bag is the perfect size to hold all your necessary items, but with sassy style! Clip onto your belt loops or attach to our leather straps for a statement piece that is as practical as it is fun. Made of the highest quality natural Elk or Bison, responsibly harvested in the United States. Each bag is different and unique due to the unfinished nature of the material and natural imperfections. Since the bags are handmade, there will be some very slight variation to the size (less than 1/4"). The stud design is hand applied and may have some inconstancy.

Overall sizes run at 5.5" high by 7" wide with a 2" gusset
Interior space is similar to a medium size fanny pack (but way cooler)

Security is important!! We sew our bags with industrial strength triple wound polyester thread, and the clips are approved at 80 pounds of pull each. The snap is high quality metal (custom options are available, just ask) and an interior snap to keep the layers together.

We do offer lots of options, If you don't see one you love, we probably have your combination and just haven't listed it.

*Please contact us for our current inventory or custom order requests.

name: 40th Anniversary Shirt
desc: We are celebrating our 40th year of leather work with a unisex cotton black shirt! It is soft and comfortable and available in sizes XS-3X. Celebrate with us while supplies last!

name: Fort Worth Cowhide Purse
desc:
This Fort Worth cowhide purse is a perfect, going out, purse. This is a simple purse with a punch! With one main pocket, it's basically deigned like a larger book. There is a smaller pocket inside good for lipstick or keys. We use a magnetic clasp as the closure and an adjustable strap. Some bags come with 10" fringe, so be sure to ask for photos of our current stock!

name: Minot Bag
desc:
This "Why Not Minot?" wristlet is a great snatch size! It has a zipper closure with a 12" wrist strap. One side has hair on cowhide, the other has organic bison leather with all the beauty of a natural hide.

Dimensions are: 6"W x 5 1/2"L

Any scars, marks, scuffs or discoloration is the natural hide, not damage. Your purchase is an acknowledgment of the leather's organic beauty and does not constitute a refund or exchange. Please view all photos carefully.

name: Medium Rustic Purses
desc:
Our Medium Rustic purse is made from deer, elk or bison hide with 5 pockets. Every bag is unique and unlike any other one. Each bag is lined with different patterns with a zipper inner pocket. If you look closely at the pictures you'll find a pocket under the front flap, the main pocket, an unlined hidden pocket (great for concealed carry), and then a smaller pocket on the outside on the back big enough for any phone currently on the market. They also all have adjustable straps!

This bag is designed to hold a lot! Big enough for tablets the size of a Kindle with the gusset. This bag keeps giving! Ask about all the colors we have in stock.
